events.name: Daniel In The Lions' Den
events.info: Daniel in the Lions' Den and Esther: The Bravest Queen, brings two timeless stories together in one unforgettable live musical adventure. Watch Esther risk everything to save her people, then journey to ancient Babylon as Daniel courageously faces the lions' den. With soaring original music, dazzling design, humor, and heart, this family-friendly production from The Originals Live is an inspiring theatrical experience for audiences of all ages. Bring the whole family and experience the unforgettable stories of two of history's bravest heroes!
events.pleaseNote: All ages require a ticket for entry. This show contains flashing lights, haze (fog), and confetti.

Add your pre-show dining experience by adding it to your ticket purchase. You must have an accompanying show ticket to enter the reception. Please enter the Tanger Center at the Box Office entrance to access the Prelude Dining Experience. Prelude Dining opens 90 minutes prior to showtime. Prelude Dining Experience includes Food Action Stations, a Chef-Carved Entrée Station and Complimentary Wine - Refill your wine to take to your seat and enjoy during the show! For sample menus and more information please visit www.TangerCenter.com/PreludeDining.

ticketLimit.info: There is an overall 4 ticket limit for this event.

boxOfficeInfo.willCallDetail: Will Call is located at the venue box office and is available 2 hours prior to performance.

venues.parkingDetail: Event parking is available on site at the Tanger Center, in downtown parking decks and on downtown city streets. Parking rates apply and may vary.

generalInfo.generalRule: All person and items entering the Tanger Center facilities are subject to inspection. For patron protection, visit www.tangercenter.com/plan-your-visit/prohibited items. Smoking is prohibited inside Tanger Center facilities
generalInfo.childRule: All ages require a ticket for entry. Everyone must have a ticket regardless of age, unless otherwise specified by the show. Children must be accompanied by an adult for all performances. Please check with the Steven Tanger Center for the Performing Arts at 336-373-7400 or the show's event page for the age requirements for tickets for the event you are interested in attending. Children under the age of six (6) are not allowed at select STCPA performances including Broadway, Concerts and Comedy shows. Some shows or events do have a different age policy and STCPA will note these on the individual show web page for each event. Family shows such as Disney Live, Paw Patrol and Sesame Street Live may require all children 1 year of age and above to have a ticket. Children must be able to site quietly in their own seat without disturbing other guests. Babies are not recommended. For the comfort and enjoyment of all guests, children who are disruptive to other guests will be asked to leave the auditorium seating area. All sales are final and no refunds will be allowed for removals due to disruption. Some shows do not appeal to every guest or every age. Broadway and other shows offer a varied range of entertainment that could include sudden loud sounds, strobes/flashing lights, adult language, adult situations, or fag and haze. Patrons are responsible for making an informed purchasing decision on show content. Each Broadway touring show has its own website that describes content and age recommendations.
